caption:
Her husband mentored Google's founders. She just gave India its first institute for American Studies, in his memory.

Asha Jadeja Motwani, a Silicon Valley venture capitalist and widow of Stanford professor Rajeev Motwani - who mentored Larry Page and Sergey Brin - established a $5 million endowment with O.P. Jindal Global University in 2025, creating the Motwani Jadeja Institute for American Studies, India's first dedicated institute for the subject.

He taught the people who built Google. She built something that will keep teaching, long after both of them are gone.

Sources: O.P. Jindal Global University, American Bazaar
